prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Predictions were generally too optimistic, except for one home wait_info test where the prediction was too low.
Evidence for most specific kinds of change remains thin because almost all categories have only a single test.
Sign-in reorder changes (2 tests) consistently showed no clear effect.
Home wait_info changes (3 tests) show mixed results: one test won (+3.5% after noise correction), while two showed no clear effect.
Adoption redesign won (+5.3% after noise correction), but evidence is still thin with only one test.
Finish new_screen (-5.5% after noise correction) and adoption hint (-3.2%) degraded performance, but evidence remains thin for both categories.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, hint: -3.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, layout: +2.0% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- adoption, redesign: +5.3% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

- choose_path, layout: +1.2% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, layout: +0.9% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- finish, new_screen: -5.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)
- home, wait_info: +0.9% after noise correction, 3 test(s)
- sign_in, hint: +1.5% after noise correction, 1 test(s) (one test only: weak evidence, not a pattern yet)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 72.9%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 66.2%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 85.5%, median 201s / mean 2336s

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop Control Quick Reference Stage: Redesign the home intro step into a two-column desktop interaction showcase explaining drag, right-click, and speech controls before finishing. (why: 3 support emails reported user confusion regarding how to control, hide, or talk to their pet after setup, while finish conversion is 64.8%.)
1: [adoption, layout] Adoption Certificate Card Refresh: Switch the adoption certificate screen to a clear grid layout to highlight summary details before finalizing adoption. (why: Adoption conversion drops to 66.2% with a high median duration of 89s; adoption redesigns previously generated a positive conversion lift.)
2: [home, wait_info] Desktop Launch & Generation Activity Feed: Display explicit generation stage details and time estimates on the waiting screen while the pet renders. (why: Home wait time is long (median 201s, mean 2336s), leading to user fatigue while awaiting desktop spawn.)
3: [choose_path, redesign] Path Selector Card Layout Overhaul: Redesign the path selection screen with card-style visual containers and asset previews. (why: Choose path drop-off is 23.8% (76.2% conversion), with long mean duration (514s) indicating visual uncertainty.)
4: [finish, new_flow] Desktop Interaction & Controls Onboarding Flow: Append an interactive controls sub-flow to teach fundamental desktop shortcuts right before finalizing setup. (why: Users wrote support tickets expressing confusion on controlling or hiding pets post-onboarding.)
5: [adoption, new_screen] Pre-Generation Photo Verification Screen: Insert a photo quality verification step right after photo upload to confirm clarity prior to adoption. (why: 3 support tickets reported custom pet generation failures or distorted results after submitting photos.)
6: [sign_in, layout] Compact Quick Sign-In Interface: Streamline the sign-in screen layout into a compact layout for rapid authentication. (why: Sign-in drops 27.1% of users, and 2 support tickets reported sign-in stalling or failing to load.)
7: [choose_path, copy] Companion Journey Value Proposition Copy: Revise story screen text to clearly communicate what desktop pets do right from the initial screen. (why: Mean duration on choose_path reaches 514s, showing hesitation due to unclear onboarding expectations.)
8: [home, notification] Background Generation Completion Alert: Enable optional background notifications on the waiting screen so users get notified when generation completes. (why: Mean home waiting time is 2336s, causing users to switch windows and forget to return to complete onboarding.)
